{{player|Hooraytio|flag=se}} |host={{player|Peppe|flag=se}} |host2= |guest= |guest2= |guest3= |guest4= |sponsor= |type=Online |format=4on4 showmatch |prizepool=Fame & Glory |localcurrency= |prizepoolusd= |date=May 10 2025, 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}} |website= |discord=discord.quake.world |twitch=Peppe_qw |twitch2= |teamfirst= |teamfirstflag= |teamsecond= |teamsecondflag= |teamthird= |teamthirdflag= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |team_number= }} The '''Golden All-Star Exhibition Match''' is a standout event of [[EQL Season 23]]. Inspired by traditional all-star games, it showcases top-tier players who step outside their regular line-ups to form new and exciting team constellations for a {{Abbr/BO5}} showdown. However, instead of stacking the roster with only the absolute best, the format ensures balanced representation: each of the top 8 clans is given one seat per map, rotating players freely. The structure is rooted in [[EQL Season 23|EQL23]]’s unusual division format, where Division 1 was split into two groups, A and B. The match capitalizes on this by fielding one team from the top 4 clans in [[EQL_Season_23/Division_1#Division_1A|Div1A]] and one from the top 4 in [[EQL_Season_23/Division_1#Division_1B|Div1B]]. The result is a high-level clash between the best from both sides of the bracket.
